comment: The unslothai/llama.cpp release a default install, `unsloth studio update` and the in-app update resolve to. Releases above it are skipped until it is bumped. UNSLOTH_LLAMA_TAG or UNSLOTH_LLAMA_RELEASE_TAG (including UNSLOTH_LLAMA_TAG=latest) override it. To bump: set release_tag to a tested release of that repo.
